role_candidate: H_when source (built-stock age distribution) - CAUTION, see notes
download_method: Full global mosaic; Earth Engine reduction recommended
city_level_summary_available: UNKNOWN (not confirmed whether pre-aggregated per urban centre in UCDB)
requires_large_download: YES raw / UNKNOWN via Earth Engine
notes: CRITICAL IDENTIFIABILITY FINDING: official product documentation defines GHS-AGE as the epoch in which 50% of the BUILT-UP SURFACE OF 2020 was first exceeded, per grid cell - i.e., it is computed relative to the 2020 (present-day) endpoint by definition. This is a real-world, official-product confirmation of risk register item A (mathematical coupling): using GHS-AGE directly as H_when would encode 2020 state into the 'historical' predictor. A safer construction would compute an analogous age-like metric using only pre-reference-epoch GHS-BUILT-S time points, not this official product as-is.
